false_negatives.golden_comment: GetWebAssets reads the cache under RLock, but after acquiring the write lock it does not re-check whether another goroutine has already populated entryPointAssetsCache; as a result, concurrent callers that initially observed nil can redundantly re-load and re-parse the manifest (file/CDN) even though the cache is now filled.

GetWebAssets assigns entryPointAssetsCache = result even when err != nil and/or result is nil; with concurrent callers (and no cache re-check after acquiring the write lock), a later caller can fail to load assets and overwrite a valid cached entry with nil, forcing future requests to reload and potentially returning errors.
